method.state_text:
the CURRENT STATE block of the prompt (between 'CURRENT STATE:
' and '
OPTIONS:
')
method.lcs: exact longest common substring of the two state texts (suffix automaton), per item
method.e1_coverage: fraction of arm X's state characters inside a 40-char window that occurs verbatim in arm Y (V7 audit E1 statistic; a measurement here, not a gate)
method.seqmatch: difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a[:30000], b[:30000], autojunk=False).ratio() on the family-0 ORIGINAL item only; 'seqmatch_cap_applied' says whether the cap truncated either text; a pair exceeding 120 s wall-clock is recorded as seqmatch_ratio=null with seqmatch_timed_out=true (difflib is super-quadratic on this text). 'seqmatch_ratio_fast' is the same statistic at a 8000-char cap, computed for every pair. CAUTION: the ratio is an ORDERED-alignment score and is cap-sensitive on pairs whose state blocks are re-ordered (e.g. L3|L6: 0.63 at 4k, 0.34 at 8k, 0.18 at 12k on P09); prefer e1_coverage and lcs_chars for similarity.
method.tokens: ESTIMATES only: chars / assumed chars-per-token by surface class; see token_estimate_ratios
method.identifier_discount: tokens matched inside the arm's own fixed role-label table are discounted before the multiset comparison; they are reported verbatim
method.assumptions_block_start: offset of the arm's quoted 'assumptions' role label divided by prompt length (the label occurs exactly once per prompt)
method.twin_difference: count of character (and UTF-8 byte) positions at which the ORIGINAL and COUNTERFACTUAL prompts differ; twins have equal length by construction
method.harness_parity: assert_arena_parity on every item and its rotate_options(item, 1) twin under all eight founders

token_estimate_ratios.note: ratios as reported measured on the live tokenizer in the brief; this script does not tokenise
